checks: Configured author and title visible and also present in PDF metadata
All required sections, references and relevant appendices present
Original scientific figure legible with full caption and no clipping
Tables match retained values; the long table repeats its header and the short interaction table stays together
No unresolved references, missing glyphs, overlap, clipped text or nearly empty trailing page
rendering: Poppler pdftoppm at 100 dpi; all eight fresh page images match the previously inspected images byte-for-byte.
reviewer: Codex assistant; direct inspection of all eight freshly rendered pages
scope: Human-style visual inspection by the same assistant, plus separate structural/log checks; not independent peer review or arXiv validation.
